title: Another Ice Boat Racing Modpack
description: Another boat racing modpack aimed to give you the best performance and experience
body:
This Modpack aims to boost Minecraft performance and to create the best gaming experience during races.
The modpack contains:
1. Bobby and Voxy - so your chunks stay loaded all the time with little impact on performance
2. Of course Sodium and its addons to make Minecraft run smoother and better
3. Shader support - Iris and Photonic for the best shaders experience evrv (Raytracing enabled)
4. Axiom and World Edit - So you can build some new tracks and become the new best ibr builder
5. Some QoL additions like a built in screenshot viewer, emoji chat and more!

What's the difference between this modpack and Sotumney's "Ice Boat Racing" modpack? Almost none. My modpack aim to be purely for performance and doesnt include mods like Flashback or Replay mod. Thats all.

Modpack includes BoatLabs server ready for you to join and race with others!

More stuff, bug&issues fixes comming soon I hope.
